from textual.app import ComposeResult, App, RenderableType
from textual.widgets import Static
from textual.binding import Binding
from rich.panel import Panel


class LogWidget(Static):
    """Scrollable log widget."""
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.log_lines = []
    
    def append_line(self, line: str) -> None:
        """Append one line to the log."""
        self.log_lines.append(line)
        self.refresh()
    
    def render(self) -> RenderableType:
        content = "\n".join(self.log_lines)
        return Panel(content, title="Log")


class LogApp(App):
    """Main Textual application with logging."""
    
    BINDINGS = [Binding("q", "quit", "Quit")]
    
    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        self.log_widget = LogWidget()
        yield self.log_widget
    
    def append_log(self, line: str) -> None:
        """Append a line to the log."""
        self.log_widget.append_line(line)
    
    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Initialize with sample log lines."""
        self.append_log("Log initialized")
        self.append_log("Ready for logging")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    app = LogApp()
    app.run()
